mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is 57 degrees with dense drizzle at Harriet Park. We have a waxing crescent moon, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Overnight, temperatures will drop to 47 degrees with rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona recently overhauled its zoning and sign ordinance and encourages all residents to use the interactive district map on the city website to verify their zoning district and polling location requirements.

Today features Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360, and trivia at Hop Haus. Looking ahead, tomorrow brings live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market on October 17.
In a noteworthy call from October 7, officers responded to a collision on Basswood Avenue between a turning vehicle and an electric motorcycle, resulting in minor injuries.
Culver's of Verona is serving up Crazy for Cookie Dough as the flavor of the day. The store is currently open until 10 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
